artboards.title: Deltas: current app vs this design

annotations.text: THE FIVE LAYER PROPERTY PANELS, one system. L0 accordion bar, group order CONTENT / APPEARANCE / TRANSFORM / EFFECTS where it applies (Fill has no Transform; Canvas has SIZE + ACTIONS). One Transform module, one paint-slot module for every Fill / Border / Shadow / Background, one .asset row, one Opacity row, one Reset Effects footer, one Advanced disclosure per module. Source is always a dropdown. Every in-body boolean is a left-aligned checkbox; the switch is only a module enable in a header. Concentric radii (8 / 6 / 4 / 3), universal 24px revert gutter down the right edge, values in editable fields.

WORKSPACE START CARD (#workspaceStart): the centred card on the canvas when nothing is loaded. Distinct from the sidebar Welcome panel to its left. Heading + one sentence, three stacked actions (Open image primary, New canvas, Open project), a dashed drop zone with the size limits. Warmer than a settings surface; still the app's tokens.

AUTO GLITTER WIZARD + LAYERS PANEL.

AUTO GLITTER (autoGlitterSettingsSection): the panel that needs a scroll region. Fixed-height flex column: a PINNED preview mode segmented, a SCROLL region holding Palette (style, colors, merge), Color Matches (a live status line + a list of region -> matched glitter rows, each with a swatch pair, name, match % and a Change chip) and Advanced (detail + checkboxes), then a STICKY FOOTER with Cancel / Create N layers. Nothing inside the scroll region is a new primitive.

LAYERS PANEL (left side, brought to parity): same Y2K bar with an icon, 'Layers', a count, a New Layer action and a collapse chevron. A layer row is one card: drag dots, a 34px swatch, name + type meta (+ a Masked / Locked badge), then visibility and lock icon buttons. States: active (accent border + tint), selected, is-hidden (dimmed), is-locked (no drag handle). A bottom bar of add / clone / go-to / delete icon buttons in the chrome.

Open: whether the layers list should adopt the same 6px card gap as the property panels' blocks (currently 4).

ASSET BROWSER. Three layouts, chosen by the collection.

GLITTER / STICKERS (category view): header (Back + title + count), search row, a 'By category / Show all' toggle, then a 2-up category folder grid. No Featured. 'Show all' (its own artboard) is every item visible, grouped under category headers, nothing collapsed.

INSIDE A CATEGORY: the armed PICKER STRIP names the destination with a Done button; Back returns to the list; the active-filter summary has a real 'Clear all' pill; a 4-up asset grid, selected one outlined, animated items badged with a corner play glyph.

SEARCH + FILTER: the filter drawer: each group a .property-group-label over a chip row, hairline dividers, NO cards, NO fourth uppercase level, NO nested scroll. Round swatch chips for colours, pills for the rest. Clear all / Show N results pinned.

BRUSH TIPS: basic brushes listed flat, then Brush SETS as folders. A SET PAGE (its own artboard) is a back line, the set name, the Source & usage credit (label, byline, dot-separated meta, a collapsed Archival note, a links row), then the tips.

SHAPES: too small for folders. Every category shown, grouped under headers, always.

Grid columns are a container query (3 / 4 / 5-up).

CHANGELOG

p15 (this round):
- Booleans: reverted to ONE toggle switch, label left, switch right-aligned to the value column (same right edge as every value). No checkboxes anywhere. Applied to Lock aspect, Relative, Resample, Scale Textures/Effects, Pressure, Selection options, Clean edges, Tune hue.
- Full-width buttons, group footers, asset cards and notes now span the FULL content width (16px each side). Only value rows reserve the revert column. Two-up buttons (Open/Save) stay side by side.
- Auto Glitter: fixed the reset-icon button (was showing browser chrome), gave Color Matches its left margin, added more match rows so the scroll actually overflows instead of leaving space under Advanced.
- Add-a-layer modal drafted: reuses the Quick Add tile grid, on a scrim, with a header and a Cancel footer.
- Canvas Scale is a number field (no slider - unbounded, like X/Y/W/H). Noted that the Size control is MOVED between No selection and Canvas Properties, never shown twice.
- Removed the placeholder 'Tap a set to open its page' line.

p14: Auto Glitter wizard (scroll + sticky footer), Layers panel at parity, workspace start card, credit block rebuilt, Text moved to the layer-panels page, multi-select actions match the Mask actions card.

p13: Reset Effects + form submits get a footer. Empty/populated both drawn + labelled. Browser: Show all = grouped headers; brush = basics + set folders; shapes = grouped headers.

p12: browser iteration; archive removed; frames + fps fallbacks. p11: 'read before implementing' + handoff. p10: state panels. p9: universal revert column (since narrowed to rows only). p8: concentric radii. p7: one row grid.

---

p14 (prior round):
- Auto Glitter wizard: scroll region under a sticky Cancel / Create N layers footer, pinned preview on top. Color Matches is a list of region -> matched-glitter rows.
- Layers panel drafted (left side) at parity: same Y2K bar, one-card layer rows with drag / swatch / name+meta / visibility / lock, active-selected-hidden-locked states, a bottom icon bar.
- Workspace start card (#workspaceStart): the centred canvas card, distinct from the sidebar Welcome panel.
- Credit block rebuilt from .asset-collection-credit: label, byline, dot-separated meta spans, a collapsed Archival-note <details>, a links row. On its own Brush set page artboard.
- Text properties moved onto the Layer property panels page with Sticker / Shape / Fill / Canvas. Pages reorganised; page 1 is now System + docs.
- Multi-select Actions: buttons are direct card children, card gap, right gutter - identical to the Mask Settings Actions card. No more extra spacing.

p13: booleans are one primitive (checkbox in body, switch only for header enable). Reset Effects + form submits get a footer (divider + own padding). Empty/populated states both drawn and labelled. Browser: Show all = grouped headers; brush tips = basics + set folders; shapes = grouped headers.

p12: browser iteration; archive removed; frames + fps with fallbacks.
p11: 'read before implementing' + handoff block; label size 11px recommended.
p10: state panels. p9: universal revert column. p8: re-grounded 4 panels, concentric radii. p7: Align split, one row grid.
